title: The Pump Has a Rhythm

time_policy.auto_pause_behavior: Freeze survival clocks at the current interaction gate until meaningful player input; display PAUSED — RESUME on the service tablet or accessible objective mirror. Never advance authored hazards during this pause.

state_ownership.authoritative_events: Listed events are requests to consume/route confirmed simulation events; narrative must not forge authoritative events or mutate resources.
state_ownership.local_flags: All completion_gate flags belong to the tutorial adapter. They are separate from canonical survival state.
state_ownership.completion: Set tutorial_complete locally once, persist log id, transition to standard simulation rate; no new canonical event is required.
state_ownership.skip: Apply the same tutorial prerequisites and post-tutorial resource state as completion; no extra items or fuel.

restrictions: No mandatory medical diving procedure is taught.
No radio choice unlock or resource giveaway occurs.
Airlock exit is service-locked until tutorial completion.

beats.objective: Compare the pump display with its independent mechanical gauge.

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Same pump. Same little hitch every fourth stroke.

presentation: Rhythmic pump beneath a hanging mug.
Stale digital telemetry becomes amber; independent gauge remains stable.
beats.failure_recovery: Repeat either inspection; no resource penalty.

beats.objective: Reconnect the isolated diagnostic sensor to INPUT 03.

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Revision C. They never changed the labels.

presentation: Three labeled terminals; loose sensor clip starts on INPUT 02.
Self-test reads STALE PACKETS CLEARED / SENSOR AGREES.
beats.hint: The service card says input three.
beats.failure_recovery: Wrong terminal yields diagnostic mismatch, then returns connector to selection. No damage or consumed parts.

beats.objective: Restore the signed sensor profile and verify it against the independent gauge.

options.explanation: Whole-station reboot would interrupt unrelated systems.
Suppression hides the mismatch without repairing it.

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Don’t silence it. Fix what it’s telling you.

presentation: Port-side hull groan after successful repair, captioned METAL CREAKING — LEFT.
beats.hint: The signed profile matches this board revision.
beats.failure_recovery: Inappropriate option explains the consequence and returns to selection; it does not execute.

beats.objective: Use the inspection drone to clear the intake guard.
presentation: Christian remains at the console; wet-side rack releases remotely.
Plastic sheet caught on guard; no organism is harmed.
A sturgeon silhouette crosses the camera after the obstruction clears.
beats.hint: Tag the sheet, then close the grabber.
beats.failure_recovery: Signal loss offers RECALL / TRY AGAIN. Onboarding drone loss cannot kill the run.

beats.objective: Inspect the surface obstruction, recall the drone and log the fault.

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Lab 04. Christian Thomas. Air is steady. For now.

presentation: Bodies move with the current and catch on a mooring line.
A hand catches, releases, then drifts downstream.
Physical task board: NEXT: INSPECT BUOY FUEL LINE.
beats.hint: Bring it home. The line is our way back.
beats.failure_recovery: Recall is assisted if the player loses orientation; the log uses an idempotent completion flag.

accessibility.captions: Every line has stable localization ID and speaker; critical non-speech sounds have descriptive captions.
accessibility.hallucinations: No critical truth is replaced; jitter may be disabled without resource advantage.

integration_acceptance: All beat gates resolve once and in order.
Five-minute target does not impose deadlines.
Inactivity auto-pause freezes survival clocks, including battery and diesel.
Every event id belongs to state_contract.json.
Death from outside tutorial suppresses queued lines and never triggers completion.
